methodology: Each component classified from on-disk evidence (file:line citations) + live verification where marked. A component may carry multiple tags. Tags: REAL/PARTIAL/DISCONNECTED/DUPLICATED/MOCKED/HARDCODED/UNUSED/BROKEN/UNTESTED/SECURITY-RISK/PRODUCTION-INCOMPLETE/EXPERIMENTAL/DEPRECATED + live-verified markers.

tag_legend.REAL: Implemented, wired, and serving its stated purpose (evidence-backed).
tag_legend.PARTIAL: Implemented but incomplete vs intended scope or has a known gap.
tag_legend.DISCONNECTED: Code exists but is not wired into the running application (no import/route/consumer).
tag_legend.DUPLICATED: Same concern solved by >=2 independent implementations with no convergence.
tag_legend.MOCKED: Behavior/data is simulated (Math.random, hardcoded fixtures), not from real backend state.
tag_legend.HARDCODED: Values/configuration are literals in source rather than config/data-driven.
tag_legend.BROKEN: Does not run / import fails / integration path fails (but not crashing the app).
tag_legend.SECURITY-RISK: Concrete security defect with fixable vector.
tag_legend.PRODUCTION-INCOMPLETE: Lacks prod gating (env requirements, secret handling, hardening).
tag_legend.EXPERIMENTAL: Prototype/sandbox, not on stable runtime path.
tag_legend.DEPRECATED: Superseded by a newer surface; retained only for compat.
